C1.rule: always reported with intervals; no verdict

C2-rep.rule: supported iff all eight reject; per-test verdicts in evidence; not a headline claim

C2a.rule: supported iff N01 rejects; N02 reported

C3a.rule: supported iff >=1 rejects and no opposite-sign rejection

C3b.rule: supported iff >=1 rejects and no opposite-sign rejection

C4b.rule: estimation claim after a priori demotion: reported with intervals; no verdict

S3.rule: supported iff TOST rejects both one-sided nulls

S4.rule: supported iff TOST rejects both one-sided nulls
